The band

Modern hard rock.
From Zagreb.
Best played loud.

◇

Diamond is a modern hard rock band from Zagreb, Croatia.

With one studio album already released and a new record on the way, the band has brought its original material, alongside a hard-hitting selection of covers, to stages in Zagreb, Rijeka and Bistra.

Diamond was named the audience winner of the 4th Svir Đir festival.
